thread:
Bea (Marketing): Quick sync for Tues's 'Benchmark Deep Dive' 3pm PT. We need a compact handoff for replay access and clips: who owns confirmation copy, public replay TTL, gating via micro-survey, HubSpot tagging, and clip delivery SLA. Keep replies short.

Noah (Events): I'll run greenroom + OBS local backup. Cloud rec + auto-transcript ON. I'll disable join_before_host and enable waiting room.

zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: https://zoom.us/j/123123123. Cloud recording ON, transcript ON. Webhook target /hooks/zoom/benchmark-upload.

Isha (Ops): Upload path s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/2026-09-14/. Default recording retention 90 days. Public replay TTL: 10 days (configurable). Webhook will emit s3_mp4, s3_srt, markers_csv_url, replay_url_ttl_days, company_domain.

Mika (Content): I'll do highlight edit + 2 social cuts (60s, 30s). Need master MP4 + SRT + markers CSV. SLA: highlights within 36 hours, full SRT within 72 hours.

Jon (Growth): HubSpot props: attended (bool), source=webinar, tag=bench-2026-09, survey_completed (bool). If company_domain matches trial list set is_trial=true -> AE alert. Flow: attended -> immediate replay + survey; no-show -> replay drip (3 emails).

Bea (Marketing): Reg confirmation draft: "You're registered  Add to calendar [link]. Join live: <zoom link>. We'll email replay & highlights within 48 hours. Optional: submit 1 prep question." Also include consent language for recording.

Isha (Ops): For gating: webhook will include "replay_download_token" and "replay_url_ttl_days": "10". We can mark full MP4 download available only after survey_completed=true. Is that desired?

Jon (Growth): Yes gate full download on survey_completed=true. Keep preview clips (60s) public without gating. Add property "clip_requested" if someone asks for full files via form.

Mika (Content): Editors need markers.csv and an "editor_priority" flag in webhook if marketing marks urgent social.

Bea (Marketing): I'll set editor_priority for launch clips. Thanks — owners recap: Noah=greenroom+local backup, Isha=upload+webhook+ttl, Mika=edits+highlights, Jon=HubSpot mapping+drips, Bea=copy+survey. Any blockers? :thumbsup:

Noah (Events): All good. I'll join 40m early for checks.

Isha (Ops): Implemented settings noted. Will ping #marketing with upload link once processing completes.

Bea (Marketing): Great. I'll push the confirmation template to /assets/email-templates/bench-deep-dive and tag it. Legal, please review TTL and gating later. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
